items.subject: Forwarding a note to a Meta team
items.body:

We co-authored at MIT’s Research Laboratory of Electronics, and your published affiliation was Meta as of 2024. Would you forward the blurb below to the relevant Meta team, given the AR metrology paper a cached search matched to Meta? No worries if you’d rather not.
